description: Translator friction from sprint 1008 (224 new keys and 343 resynced keys, 26 languages, 2026-10-08).

entries.complaint: The one-word label Above names no object; it is unclear what is above.
readings: The elevation typed in the field above (chosen)
Above in the sense of higher altitude
entries.resolution: Tom's ruled word: the option means the elevation typed in the box above. Every translator rendered that reading.

entries.complaint: English now says amber ring while the visible ring color was rendered gold elsewhere in this file; unsure whether a distinct color word is intended.
readings: gold/amber ring, rendered with the existing gold word (chosen)
entries.resolution: Amber vs gold for the scenario ring colour: either names the colour on screen.

entries.complaint: alt. is an abbreviation with no established Amharic short form, so the full word was used.
entries.resolution: Writing the full word, or the language's own abbreviation, is what the $ec_lang_syn note asks for.

entries.complaint: Value is only placeholders {id}: {property} {value}; no words to translate, so it is byte-identical to English

entries.resolution: Correctly identical to English in this language; exempted per key and language in translation_exempt_keys.json at sprint close.

entries.complaint: 'Hides the Calculate button' has no stated condition: does it hide the button when the setting is on or when it is turned off?

entries.resolution: PROPOSED English for Tom: 'Turn off if recalculation is too slow. While this is on, the Calculate button is hidden.' Two translators could not tell which state hides the button.
